title: "CROP: Certifying Robust Policies for Reinforcement Learning through Functional Smoothing"

en.text: Reinforcement learning has quietly moved out of games and simulators and into places where a wrong move is expensive: lane-keeping in self-driving cars, position sizing in automated trading, control loops in robotics. In these settings an agent watches a stream of state observations and picks an action at every step. The uncomfortable part is that those observations can be tampered with. Researchers have shown that an adversary who nudges the input state by an amount too small for a human to notice can reliably flip the agent's decision, and a handful of flipped decisions is all it takes to steer a policy off a cliff.

The usual response has been to make policies empirically tougher through adversarial training, smoothness regularization, or noise injection. Each buys resistance to the attacks it was tested against, and each has, in turn, been broken by a stronger or better-adapted attacker. That cycle exposes the real gap: passing today's attacks tells you almost nothing about tomorrow's. What safety-critical reinforcement learning actually needs is a certificate, a proof that the policy stays reliable against every perturbation within a bounded budget, not merely the specific attacks that someone happened to try.

CROP, presented at ICLR 2022 by researchers from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Washington University in St. Louis, and Carnegie Mellon University, is the first unified framework to provide exactly that for reinforcement learning. It certifies robustness at 2 levels, the stability of the action chosen at each state and a provable lower bound on the cumulative reward collected across an entire trajectory, and uses those tools to benchmark 9 existing robust RL methods across 4 environments on a common, provable footing.
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09292 · Project and leaderboard: https://crop-leaderboard.github.io
Why robustness in RL resists certification

Certified robustness is a solved-enough problem for image classifiers, and the workhorse behind it is randomized smoothing: add Gaussian noise to the input, average the classifier's output, and the smoothed classifier comes with a provable radius around each input inside which its prediction cannot change. Lifting the same recipe straight into reinforcement learning is tempting, but two obstacles stand in the way.

The first is the output itself. In classification the confidence score lives in a known range from zero to one and behaves like a probability, which is exactly what makes the radius calculation work. A Q-network is neither: its value estimates have an unknown, unbounded range and are not probabilities at all. The second obstacle is more conceptual. Certifying a single action is not the same as certifying an agent. What ultimately matters is the reward accumulated over a whole sequence of decisions, and a policy can be locally stable at every state yet still bleed reward under a sustained attack. CROP is built to clear both hurdles at once.
Functional smoothing: two criteria, three algorithms

The engine underneath CROP is functional smoothing. At each state, and separately for each candidate action, the method perturbs the state with Gaussian noise and averages the trained Q-network's output over that noise, producing a smoothed value function. A key lemma shows this smoothed function is Lipschitz continuous, meaning it cannot change too quickly, with a constant that shrinks as the smoothing variance σ grows. Continuity is the lever: if the value function cannot swing wildly, then a small perturbation cannot swing the chosen action either.

From that continuity the paper defines 2 certification criteria and turns each into a concrete algorithm. To keep the range problem manageable, the Q-output range is pre-estimated on a subset of states, and the smoothed values are bounded with a concentration inequality so that the certificate stays sound even under Monte Carlo sampling of the noise.

en.text: CROP-LoAct handles the action level. For each state it computes a certified radius r from the gap between the best and the runner-up smoothed action-values: as long as the perturbation is smaller than r, the top action stays on top and the policy's decision is provably unchanged. The radius exposes a genuine trade-off in σ. More smoothing makes the value function steadier, which helps, but it also compresses the margin between the top two actions, which hurts, so the best amount of noise is a balance rather than a maximum.
What the certificates reveal

Running CROP-LoAct across the 9 methods produces a per-state certified radius at every time step, which reads directly as how much perturbation each policy can absorb before its action would flip. The figure below tracks that radius over time on two Atari games, Freeway and Pong, with each column corresponding to a different smoothing level σ.

en.caption: Figure 1. Per-state certified action radius r over time for all 9 methods, on Freeway (top) and Pong (bottom); each column is one smoothing variance σ. RadialRL (magenta) is the most certifiably robust method on Freeway, while SA-MDP (CVX) (purple) leads on Pong. Shaded bands are standard deviations and are small.

en.text: Two clear winners emerge, and they differ by environment. On Freeway, RadialRL holds the highest certified radius across every smoothing level, which fits its design: it explicitly optimizes against worst-case perturbations. On Pong, SA-MDP with the convex relaxation is the most certifiably robust. Reassuringly, these certified rankings line up with what people had already observed empirically. The proof agrees with the practice, and that consistency is what makes a certificate worth trusting.

The per-state view also surfaces structure that a single robustness number would hide. On Pong, every method's certified radius rises and falls in a regular rhythm rather than staying flat, and lining the curve up against the game frames explains why it does so.

en.caption: Figure 7. Two consecutive periods of the certified radius on Pong (top of each panel), aligned with the game frames they correspond to (bottom). Robustness peaks at confident moments, for example when the ball is heading toward the paddle, and dips when the next action matters less. The two periods are nearly identical.

en.text: The reading is intuitive. When the ball is racing toward the paddle the correct action is unambiguous, the margin between the best and second-best action is wide, and the certified radius is large; in the lull between rallies the decision is nearly arbitrary and the radius collapses. This suggests that robustness is not a fixed property of a policy but something that ebbs and flows with how consequential each state is, a hint that future defenses might concentrate their effort on the handful of states that actually matter most.
From single actions to whole trajectories

Certifying actions is only half of CROP. The other half asks the question a practitioner really cares about: under any bounded attack, how much reward is the policy guaranteed to collect? CROP answers with three reward bounds of increasing tightness. CROP-GRe uses global smoothing to bound the expected reward (JE) and the 50% percentile reward (Jp), while CROP-LoRe runs an adaptive tree search over trajectories to certify an absolute lower bound (J). The figure below plots all three against the attack magnitude ε; solid lines are the certified bounds, dashed lines are the empirical reward under an actual PGD attack.

en.caption: Figure 3. Certified cumulative-reward bounds versus attack magnitude ε for all 9 methods: the expectation bound JE (top row), the 50% percentile bound Jp (middle), and the absolute lower bound J (bottom). Each column is one smoothing variance σ. Solid lines are certified bounds; dashed lines are the empirical reward under PGD.

en.text: The three bounds are not equally useful, and the gap between them is the point. The expectation bound JE is loose: it drops steeply as the attack grows and quickly becomes uninformative. The percentile bound Jp is far tighter. The absolute lower bound J from CROP-LoRe is tighter still, and across a wide range of attack magnitudes it sits right on top of the empirical PGD curve, a zero gap that says the certificate is not merely valid but essentially exact. When a provable lower bound coincides with what the strongest available attack actually achieves, there is little robustness left unaccounted for.
How much to smooth

Because the smoothing variance σ controls the whole certificate, the paper studies it directly, and the answer is that the right amount of noise depends on the environment. On Freeway, which tolerates large perturbations, robustness for the strong methods keeps climbing as σ grows all the way to 1.0. On Pong the opposite holds: too much smoothing washes out the value margins, and a moderate σ between 0.01 and 0.03 is best for nearly every method. There is no universal setting. σ is a knob to tune per environment, and CROP makes the trade-off measurable instead of guessed.
Why it matters

The lasting message of CROP is that robustness in reinforcement learning does not have to be a matter of hope. By smoothing the value function you can prove that an agent's action stays fixed within a certified radius, and prove a lower bound on the reward it will collect under any attack inside a fixed budget. Applied to 9 methods across 4 environments, those certificates turn out to be not only sound but often tight, matching what real attacks achieve.

The honest boundaries are worth stating. The certificates cover L2-norm bounded perturbations of the state observation, they rest on Monte Carlo sampling with its usual statistical caveats, and they inherit the σ trade-off that has to be tuned per environment. What CROP contributes is a common, provable yardstick: instead of comparing robust RL methods by which attacks they happen to survive, the field can now compare them by what they can be proven to guarantee. The authors release their results as an open leaderboard, inviting the community to certify still more methods and more environments.

zh.text: 强化学习正在悄悄走出游戏和仿真环境，进入那些「一步走错、代价高昂」的场景：自动驾驶里的车道保持、自动交易中的仓位决策、机器人里的控制回路。在这些系统里，智能体（agent）不断观察状态（state），并在每一步选择一个动作。令人不安的是，这些观测是可以被篡改的。已有研究表明，只要对手对输入状态施加一点人眼几乎察觉不到的扰动，就能稳定地改变智能体的决策，而若干个被改变的决策，往往就足以把一个策略推向危险的方向。
常见的应对方式，是让策略在经验上「更抗揍」：对抗训练、光滑性正则、噪声注入。它们各自能挡住测试时用到的那些攻击，却又一次次被更强、更有针对性的攻击攻破。这个循环暴露出真正的缺口：能扛住今天的攻击，几乎说明不了明天会怎样。安全攸关的强化学习真正需要的，是一份认证（certification）：证明策略在给定扰动预算内、面对任意扰动都保持可靠，而不只是面对有人恰好试过的那几种攻击。
CROP 正是为强化学习提供这样一份证明的首个统一框架，来自伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校、圣路易斯华盛顿大学与卡内基梅隆大学，发表于 ICLR 2022。它在 2 个层面上认证鲁棒性：每一步所选动作的稳定性，以及整条轨迹上累积奖励的可证明下界；并用这套工具，在 4 个环境上对 9 种已有的鲁棒 RL 方法做了统一、可证明的评测。
论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09292 · 项目与排行榜：https://crop-leaderboard.github.io
为什么强化学习的鲁棒性难以「认证」
对图像分类器来说，认证鲁棒性已经是一个相对成熟的问题，背后的主力工具是随机平滑（randomized smoothing）：给输入加上高斯噪声、对分类器输出取平均，得到的平滑分类器就自带一个可证明的半径——在这个半径内，输入无论怎么扰动，预测都不会改变。把这套配方直接搬到强化学习里，看起来很诱人，但有两处障碍横在中间。
第一处障碍在输出本身。分类里的置信度落在一个已知的、从零到一的区间里，像一个概率，正是这一点让半径的推导成立；而 Q 网络的输出既不在已知范围内、也不是概率。第二处障碍更偏概念：认证单步动作，并不等于认证整个智能体。真正重要的是一整串决策累积出的奖励，一个策略可能在每个状态上都局部稳定，却仍然在持续攻击下不断损失奖励。CROP 要同时跨过这两道坎。
函数平滑：两类标准，三种算法

CROP 的核心引擎是函数平滑（functional smoothing）。在每个状态、针对每个候选动作，方法先用高斯噪声扰动状态，再对训练好的 Q 网络输出在噪声上取平均，得到一个平滑后的值函数。一条关键引理表明，这个平滑值函数是 Lipschitz 连续的，也就是变化不会太快，而且这个常数会随着平滑方差 σ 增大而减小。连续性正是撬动一切的杠杆：既然值函数不会剧烈摆动，小扰动也就无法让所选动作发生翻转。
由这份连续性，论文定义了 2 类认证标准，并把每一类都落成一个具体算法。为了驯服「输出范围未知」这个问题，Q 输出的范围会先在一小部分状态上预估出来，再用集中不等式给平滑值加上界，使得证书在噪声的蒙特卡洛采样下依然可靠。

zh.caption: 表 1 CROP 的三种算法、各自使用的平滑方式，以及它们分别认证的目标。
rows: 单步动作的认证半径 r；扰动在 r 内动作被证明不变
累积奖励的期望界 JE 与 50% 分位界 Jp 两个全局界
累积奖励的绝对下界 J，三者中最紧

zh.text: CROP-LoAct 负责动作层面。对每个状态，它用最优动作与次优动作的平滑值之间的间隔，算出一个认证半径 r：只要扰动小于 r，排在最前的动作就仍然最前，策略的决策便被证明不会改变。这个半径也揭示了 σ 上一个真实的权衡——平滑越多，值函数越稳，这是好事；但它同时压窄了前两个动作之间的间隔，这是坏事。于是最优的噪声量是一个平衡点，而不是越大越好。
认证结果告诉了我们什么
把 CROP-LoAct 跑遍 9 种方法，就能得到每一步的认证半径，它可以被直接读作：在动作发生翻转之前，每个策略还能吸收多大的扰动。下图记录了这个半径在两款 Atari 游戏 Freeway 和 Pong 上随时间的变化，每一列对应一个不同的平滑水平 σ。

zh.caption: 图 1 全部 9 种方法在 Freeway（上）与 Pong（下）上、每一步的动作认证半径 r 随时间的变化；每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL（品红）是最可证明鲁棒的方法；在 Pong 上则是 SA-MDP (CVX)（紫色）领先。阴影为标准差，且很小。

zh.text: 两位赢家浮现出来，而且随环境而不同。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL 在每个平滑水平下都保持最高的认证半径，这与它的设计相符：它显式地针对最坏情况扰动做优化。在 Pong 上，采用凸松弛的 SA-MDP (CVX) 最为可证明鲁棒。令人安心的是，这些「可证明」的排名，与人们此前在经验上观察到的结果相互吻合——证明与实践一致，正是这种一致性让一份证书值得信赖。
逐状态的视角还揭示出一个被「单一鲁棒性数字」掩盖的结构。在 Pong 上，每种方法的认证半径并非一条平线，而是有规律地起伏；把这条曲线和游戏画面对齐，原因便一目了然。

zh.caption: 图 7 Pong 上认证半径的两个连续周期（每格上方），与其对应的游戏画面（下方）对齐。鲁棒性在「有把握」的时刻达到峰值——例如球正朝球拍飞来时——而在下一步动作无关紧要时回落。两个周期几乎完全相同。

zh.text: 这个解读很直观：当球正朝球拍飞来，正确的动作毫无悬念，最优与次优动作之间的间隔很宽，认证半径就大；而在两个回合之间的间歇里，选哪个动作都差不多，半径随之塌缩。这表明，鲁棒性并不是策略的一个固定属性，而是随着「每个状态有多关键」而涨落——这也暗示，未来的防御或许可以把力气集中在那些真正要紧的状态上。
从单步动作到整条轨迹
认证动作只是 CROP 的一半。另一半回答的是实践者真正关心的问题：在任意有界攻击下，策略能保证拿到多少奖励？CROP 给出三个由松到紧的奖励界。CROP-GRe 用全局平滑给出期望奖励界（JE）和 50% 分位奖励界（Jp）；CROP-LoRe 则在轨迹上做自适应树搜索，认证出一个绝对下界（J）。下图把这三者对攻击幅度 ε 作图：实线是认证界，虚线是在真实 PGD 攻击下的经验奖励。

zh.caption: 图 3 全部 9 种方法的累积奖励认证界随攻击幅度 ε 的变化：期望界 JE（上行）、50% 分位界 Jp（中行）与绝对下界 J（下行）。每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。实线为认证界，虚线为 PGD 下的经验奖励。

zh.text: 三个界并非同样有用，它们之间的差距才是重点。期望界 JE 很松——随攻击增大迅速下滑，很快就失去信息量。分位界 Jp 要紧得多。而 CROP-LoRe 给出的绝对下界 J 更紧：在很大一段攻击幅度范围内，它几乎与经验 PGD 曲线严丝合缝地重合，这种「零间隙」说明证书不只是成立，而是基本精确。当一个可证明的下界，恰好等于现有最强攻击真正打出的结果时，几乎就没有多少鲁棒性被漏算了。
到底该平滑多少
既然平滑方差 σ 决定了整份证书，论文就直接研究它，结论是：合适的噪声量取决于环境。在能容忍大扰动的 Freeway 上，强方法的鲁棒性会随 σ 一路上升，直到 1.0。Pong 上则相反：平滑过头会抹平值间隔，对几乎所有方法而言，0.01 到 0.03 之间的中等 σ 最好。并不存在一个通用设置——σ 是一个要按环境去调的旋钮，而 CROP 让这个权衡变得可度量，而不是靠猜。
为什么这项工作重要
CROP 留下的核心信息是：强化学习的鲁棒性，不必只是一种「但愿如此」。通过平滑值函数，你可以证明智能体的动作在一个认证半径内保持不变，也可以证明它在给定预算内任意攻击下所能拿到奖励的下界。把这套方法用到 4 个环境上的 9 种方法，得到的证书不仅成立，而且常常很紧——与真实攻击打出的结果相当。
该说清的边界也值得一提。这些证书针对的是状态观测上 L2 范数有界的扰动，依赖蒙特卡洛采样、也就带着相应的统计假设，并且继承了那个需要按环境调的 σ 权衡。CROP 真正贡献的，是一把「可证明」的统一标尺：与其比较各种鲁棒 RL 方法「碰巧扛住了哪些攻击」，这个领域现在可以按「能被证明保证什么」来比较它们。作者把结果做成了一个开放排行榜，邀请更多人来认证更多方法、更多环境。

zh.text: 为什么强化学习的鲁棒性难以「认证」
对图像分类器来说，认证鲁棒性已经是一个相对成熟的问题，背后的主力工具是随机平滑（randomized smoothing）：给输入加上高斯噪声、对分类器输出取平均，得到的平滑分类器就自带一个可证明的半径——在这个半径内，输入无论怎么扰动，预测都不会改变。把这套配方直接搬到强化学习里，看起来很诱人，但有两处障碍横在中间。
第一处障碍在输出本身。分类里的置信度落在一个已知的、从零到一的区间里，像一个概率，正是这一点让半径的推导成立；而 Q 网络的输出既不在已知范围内、也不是概率。第二处障碍更偏概念：认证单步动作，并不等于认证整个智能体。真正重要的是一整串决策累积出的奖励，一个策略可能在每个状态上都局部稳定，却仍然在持续攻击下不断损失奖励。CROP 要同时跨过这两道坎。

RadialRL (magenta) is the most certifiably robust method on Freeway, while SA-MDP (CVX) (purple) leads on Pong. Shaded bands are standard deviations and are small.

en.text: Why robustness in RL resists certification

Certified robustness is a solved-enough problem for image classifiers, and the workhorse behind it is randomized smoothing: add Gaussian noise to the input, average the classifier's output, and the smoothed classifier comes with a provable radius around each input inside which its prediction cannot change. Lifting the same recipe straight into reinforcement learning is tempting, but two obstacles stand in the way.

The first is the output itself. In classification the confidence score lives in a known range from zero to one and behaves like a probability, which is exactly what makes the radius calculation work. A Q-network is neither: its value estimates have an unknown, unbounded range and are not probabilities at all. The second obstacle is more conceptual. Certifying a single action is not the same as certifying an agent. What ultimately matters is the reward accumulated over a whole sequence of decisions, and a policy can be locally stable at every state yet still bleed reward under a sustained attack. CROP is built to clear both hurdles at once.

zh.caption: 图 1 全部 9 种方法在 Freeway（上）与 Pong（下）上、每一步的动作认证半径 r 随时间的变化；每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL（品红）是最可证明鲁棒的方法；在 Pong 上则是 SA-MDP (CVX)（紫色）领先。阴影为标准差，且很小。

zh.text: 为什么这项工作重要
CROP 留下的核心信息是：强化学习的鲁棒性，不必只是一种「但愿如此」。通过平滑值函数，你可以证明智能体的动作在一个认证半径内保持不变，也可以证明它在给定预算内任意攻击下所能拿到奖励的下界。把这套方法用到 4 个环境上的 9 种方法，得到的证书不仅成立，而且常常很紧——与真实攻击打出的结果相当。
该说清的边界也值得一提。这些证书针对的是状态观测上 L2 范数有界的扰动，依赖蒙特卡洛采样、也就带着相应的统计假设，并且继承了那个需要按环境调的 σ 权衡。CROP 真正贡献的，是一把「可证明」的统一标尺：与其比较各种鲁棒 RL 方法「碰巧扛住了哪些攻击」，这个领域现在可以按「能被证明保证什么」来比较它们。作者把结果做成了一个开放排行榜，邀请更多人来认证更多方法、更多环境。

zh.title: ICLR 2022 | 强化学习的鲁棒性，不只是测出来，还要证出来
zh.subtitle: CROP：用函数平滑为强化学习策略提供可证明的鲁棒性认证，覆盖动作与累积奖励两个层面

en.caption: Figure 1. Per-state certified action radius r over time for all 9 methods, on Freeway (top) and Pong (bottom); each column is one smoothing variance σ. RadialRL (magenta) is the most certifiably robust method on Freeway, while SA-MDP (CVX) (purple) leads on Pong. Shaded bands are standard deviations and are small.

en.text: Reinforcement learning has quietly moved out of games and simulators and into places where a wrong move is expensive: lane-keeping in self-driving cars, position sizing in automated trading, control loops in robotics. In these settings an agent watches a stream of state observations and picks an action at every step. The uncomfortable part is that those observations can be tampered with. Researchers have shown that an adversary who nudges the input state by an amount too small for a human to notice can reliably flip the agent's decision, and a handful of flipped decisions is all it takes to steer a policy off a cliff.

The usual response has been to make policies empirically tougher through adversarial training, smoothness regularization, or noise injection. Each buys resistance to the attacks it was tested against, and each has, in turn, been broken by a stronger or better-adapted attacker. That cycle exposes the real gap: passing today's attacks tells you almost nothing about tomorrow's. What safety-critical reinforcement learning actually needs is a certificate, a proof that the policy stays reliable against every perturbation within a bounded budget, not merely the specific attacks that someone happened to try.

CROP, presented at ICLR 2022 by researchers from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Washington University in St. Louis, and Carnegie Mellon University, is the first unified framework to provide exactly that for reinforcement learning. It certifies robustness at 2 levels, the stability of the action chosen at each state and a provable lower bound on the cumulative reward collected across an entire trajectory, and uses those tools to benchmark 9 existing robust RL methods across 4 environments on a common, provable footing.
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09292 · Project and leaderboard: https://crop-leaderboard.github.io
Functional smoothing: two criteria, three algorithms

The engine underneath CROP is functional smoothing. At each state, and separately for each candidate action, the method perturbs the state with Gaussian noise and averages the trained Q-network's output over that noise, producing a smoothed value function. A key lemma shows this smoothed function is Lipschitz continuous, meaning it cannot change too quickly, with a constant that shrinks as the smoothing variance σ grows. Continuity is the lever: if the value function cannot swing wildly, then a small perturbation cannot swing the chosen action either.

From that continuity the paper defines 2 certification criteria and turns each into a concrete algorithm. To keep the range problem manageable, the Q-output range is pre-estimated on a subset of states, and the smoothed values are bounded with a concentration inequality so that the certificate stays sound even under Monte Carlo sampling of the noise.

en.caption: Table 1. The three algorithms in CROP, the smoothing they use, and what each one certifies.
rows: Certified radius r for the per-state action; the action is provably unchanged within r
Expected-reward bound JE and the 50% percentile reward bound Jp
Absolute lower bound J on cumulative reward, the tightest of the three

en.text: CROP-LoAct handles the action level. For each state it computes a certified radius r from the gap between the best and the runner-up smoothed action-values: as long as the perturbation is smaller than r, the top action stays on top and the policy's decision is provably unchanged. The radius exposes a genuine trade-off in σ. More smoothing makes the value function steadier, which helps, but it also compresses the margin between the top two actions, which hurts, so the best amount of noise is a balance rather than a maximum.

zh.caption: 图 1 全部 9 种方法在 Freeway（上）与 Pong（下）上、每一步的动作认证半径 r 随时间的变化；每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL（品红）是最可证明鲁棒的方法；在 Pong 上则是 SA-MDP (CVX)（紫色）领先。阴影为标准差，且很小。

zh.text: 强化学习正在悄悄走出游戏和仿真环境，进入那些「一步走错、代价高昂」的场景：自动驾驶里的车道保持、自动交易中的仓位决策、机器人里的控制回路。在这些系统里，智能体（agent）不断观察状态（state），并在每一步选择一个动作。令人不安的是，这些观测是可以被篡改的。已有研究表明，只要对手对输入状态施加一点人眼几乎察觉不到的扰动，就能稳定地改变智能体的决策，而若干个被改变的决策，往往就足以把一个策略推向危险的方向。
常见的应对方式，是让策略在经验上「更抗揍」：对抗训练、光滑性正则、噪声注入。它们各自能挡住测试时用到的那些攻击，却又一次次被更强、更有针对性的攻击攻破。这个循环暴露出真正的缺口：能扛住今天的攻击，几乎说明不了明天会怎样。安全攸关的强化学习真正需要的，是一份认证（certification）：证明策略在给定扰动预算内、面对任意扰动都保持可靠，而不只是面对有人恰好试过的那几种攻击。
CROP 正是为强化学习提供这样一份证明的首个统一框架，来自伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校、圣路易斯华盛顿大学与卡内基梅隆大学，发表于 ICLR 2022。它在 2 个层面上认证鲁棒性：每一步所选动作的稳定性，以及整条轨迹上累积奖励的可证明下界；并用这套工具，在 4 个环境上对 9 种已有的鲁棒 RL 方法做了统一、可证明的评测。
论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09292 · 项目与排行榜：https://crop-leaderboard.github.io
函数平滑：两类标准，三种算法

CROP 的核心引擎是函数平滑（functional smoothing）。在每个状态、针对每个候选动作，方法先用高斯噪声扰动状态，再对训练好的 Q 网络输出在噪声上取平均，得到一个平滑后的值函数。一条关键引理表明，这个平滑值函数是 Lipschitz 连续的，也就是变化不会太快，而且这个常数会随着平滑方差 σ 增大而减小。连续性正是撬动一切的杠杆：既然值函数不会剧烈摆动，小扰动也就无法让所选动作发生翻转。
由这份连续性，论文定义了 2 类认证标准，并把每一类都落成一个具体算法。为了驯服「输出范围未知」这个问题，Q 输出的范围会先在一小部分状态上预估出来，再用集中不等式给平滑值加上界，使得证书在噪声的蒙特卡洛采样下依然可靠。

zh.caption: 表 1 CROP 的三种算法、各自使用的平滑方式，以及它们分别认证的目标。
rows: 单步动作的认证半径 r；扰动在 r 内动作被证明不变
累积奖励的期望界 JE 与 50% 分位界 Jp 两个全局界
累积奖励的绝对下界 J，三者中最紧

zh.text: CROP-LoAct 负责动作层面。对每个状态，它用最优动作与次优动作的平滑值之间的间隔，算出一个认证半径 r：只要扰动小于 r，排在最前的动作就仍然最前，策略的决策便被证明不会改变。这个半径也揭示了 σ 上一个真实的权衡——平滑越多，值函数越稳，这是好事；但它同时压窄了前两个动作之间的间隔，这是坏事。于是最优的噪声量是一个平衡点，而不是越大越好。

zh.text: 从单步动作到整条轨迹
认证动作只是 CROP 的一半。另一半回答的是实践者真正关心的问题：在任意有界攻击下，策略能保证拿到多少奖励？CROP 给出三个由松到紧的奖励界。CROP-GRe 用全局平滑给出期望奖励界（JE）和 50% 分位奖励界（Jp）；CROP-LoRe 则在轨迹上做自适应树搜索，认证出一个绝对下界（J）。下图把这三者对攻击幅度 ε 作图：实线是认证界，虚线是在真实 PGD 攻击下的经验奖励。

zh.caption: 图 3 全部 9 种方法的累积奖励认证界随攻击幅度 ε 的变化：期望界 JE（上行）、50% 分位界 Jp（中行）与绝对下界 J（下行）。每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。实线为认证界，虚线为 PGD 下的经验奖励。

zh.text: 三个界并非同样有用，它们之间的差距才是重点。期望界 JE 很松——随攻击增大迅速下滑，很快就失去信息量。分位界 Jp 要紧得多。而 CROP-LoRe 给出的绝对下界 J 更紧：在很大一段攻击幅度范围内，它几乎与经验 PGD 曲线严丝合缝地重合，这种「零间隙」说明证书不只是成立，而是基本精确。当一个可证明的下界，恰好等于现有最强攻击真正打出的结果时，几乎就没有多少鲁棒性被漏算了。

Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09292 · Project and leaderboard: https://crop-leaderboard.github.io
What the certificates reveal

Running CROP-LoAct across the 9 methods produces a per-state certified radius at every time step, which reads directly as how much perturbation each policy can absorb before its action would flip. The figure below tracks that radius over time on two Atari games, Freeway and Pong, with each column corresponding to a different smoothing level σ.

en.caption: Figure 1. Per-state certified action radius r over time for all 9 methods, on Freeway (top) and Pong (bottom); each column is one smoothing variance σ. RadialRL (magenta) is the most certifiably robust method on Freeway, while SA-MDP (CVX) (purple) leads on Pong. Shaded bands are standard deviations and are small.

en.text: Two clear winners emerge, and they differ by environment. On Freeway, RadialRL holds the highest certified radius across every smoothing level, which fits its design: it explicitly optimizes against worst-case perturbations. On Pong, SA-MDP with the convex relaxation is the most certifiably robust. Reassuringly, these certified rankings line up with what people had already observed empirically. The proof agrees with the practice, and that consistency is what makes a certificate worth trusting.

The per-state view also surfaces structure that a single robustness number would hide. On Pong, every method's certified radius rises and falls in a regular rhythm rather than staying flat, and lining the curve up against the game frames explains why it does so.

en.caption: Figure 7. Two consecutive periods of the certified radius on Pong (top of each panel), aligned with the game frames they correspond to (bottom). Robustness peaks at confident moments, for example when the ball is heading toward the paddle, and dips when the next action matters less. The two periods are nearly identical.

en.text: The reading is intuitive. When the ball is racing toward the paddle the correct action is unambiguous, the margin between the best and second-best action is wide, and the certified radius is large; in the lull between rallies the decision is nearly arbitrary and the radius collapses. This suggests that robustness is not a fixed property of a policy but something that ebbs and flows with how consequential each state is, a hint that future defenses might concentrate their effort on the handful of states that actually matter most.

zh.text: 认证结果告诉了我们什么
把 CROP-LoAct 跑遍 9 种方法，就能得到每一步的认证半径，它可以被直接读作：在动作发生翻转之前，每个策略还能吸收多大的扰动。下图记录了这个半径在两款 Atari 游戏 Freeway 和 Pong 上随时间的变化，每一列对应一个不同的平滑水平 σ。

zh.caption: 图 1 全部 9 种方法在 Freeway（上）与 Pong（下）上、每一步的动作认证半径 r 随时间的变化；每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL（品红）是最可证明鲁棒的方法；在 Pong 上则是 SA-MDP (CVX)（紫色）领先。阴影为标准差，且很小。

zh.text: 两位赢家浮现出来，而且随环境而不同。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL 在每个平滑水平下都保持最高的认证半径，这与它的设计相符：它显式地针对最坏情况扰动做优化。在 Pong 上，采用凸松弛的 SA-MDP (CVX) 最为可证明鲁棒。令人安心的是，这些「可证明」的排名，与人们此前在经验上观察到的结果相互吻合——证明与实践一致，正是这种一致性让一份证书值得信赖。
逐状态的视角还揭示出一个被「单一鲁棒性数字」掩盖的结构。在 Pong 上，每种方法的认证半径并非一条平线，而是有规律地起伏；把这条曲线和游戏画面对齐，原因便一目了然。

zh.caption: 图 7 Pong 上认证半径的两个连续周期（每格上方），与其对应的游戏画面（下方）对齐。鲁棒性在「有把握」的时刻达到峰值——例如球正朝球拍飞来时——而在下一步动作无关紧要时回落。两个周期几乎完全相同。

zh.text: 这个解读很直观：当球正朝球拍飞来，正确的动作毫无悬念，最优与次优动作之间的间隔很宽，认证半径就大；而在两个回合之间的间歇里，选哪个动作都差不多，半径随之塌缩。这表明，鲁棒性并不是策略的一个固定属性，而是随着「每个状态有多关键」而涨落——这也暗示，未来的防御或许可以把力气集中在那些真正要紧的状态上。
从单步动作到整条轨迹
认证动作只是 CROP 的一半。另一半回答的是实践者真正关心的问题：在任意有界攻击下，策略能保证拿到多少奖励？CROP 给出三个由松到紧的奖励界。CROP-GRe 用全局平滑给出期望奖励界（JE）和 50% 分位奖励界（Jp）；CROP-LoRe 则在轨迹上做自适应树搜索，认证出一个绝对下界（J）。下图把这三者对攻击幅度 ε 作图：实线是认证界，虚线是在真实 PGD 攻击下的经验奖励。

zh.caption: 图 3 全部 9 种方法的累积奖励认证界随攻击幅度 ε 的变化：期望界 JE（上行）、50% 分位界 Jp（中行）与绝对下界 J（下行）。每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。实线为认证界，虚线为 PGD 下的经验奖励。

zh.text: 三个界并非同样有用，它们之间的差距才是重点。期望界 JE 很松——随攻击增大迅速下滑，很快就失去信息量。分位界 Jp 要紧得多。而 CROP-LoRe 给出的绝对下界 J 更紧：在很大一段攻击幅度范围内，它几乎与经验 PGD 曲线严丝合缝地重合，这种「零间隙」说明证书不只是成立，而是基本精确。当一个可证明的下界，恰好等于现有最强攻击真正打出的结果时，几乎就没有多少鲁棒性被漏算了。

zh.subtitle: CROP：用函数平滑为强化学习策略提供可证明的鲁棒性认证，覆盖动作与累积奖励两个层面

en.caption: Figure 1. Per-state certified action radius r over time for all 9 methods, on Freeway (top) and Pong (bottom); each column is one smoothing variance σ. RadialRL (magenta) is the most certifiably robust method on Freeway, while SA-MDP (CVX) (purple) leads on Pong. Shaded bands are standard deviations and are small.

en.text: Functional smoothing: two criteria, three algorithms

The engine underneath CROP is functional smoothing. At each state, and separately for each candidate action, the method perturbs the state with Gaussian noise and averages the trained Q-network's output over that noise, producing a smoothed value function. A key lemma shows this smoothed function is Lipschitz continuous, meaning it cannot change too quickly, with a constant that shrinks as the smoothing variance σ grows. Continuity is the lever: if the value function cannot swing wildly, then a small perturbation cannot swing the chosen action either.

From that continuity the paper defines 2 certification criteria and turns each into a concrete algorithm. To keep the range problem manageable, the Q-output range is pre-estimated on a subset of states, and the smoothed values are bounded with a concentration inequality so that the certificate stays sound even under Monte Carlo sampling of the noise.

en.caption: Table 1. The three algorithms in CROP, the smoothing they use, and what each one certifies.
rows: Certified radius r for the per-state action; the action is provably unchanged within r
Expected-reward bound JE and the 50% percentile reward bound Jp
Absolute lower bound J on cumulative reward, the tightest of the three

en.text: CROP-LoAct handles the action level. For each state it computes a certified radius r from the gap between the best and the runner-up smoothed action-values: as long as the perturbation is smaller than r, the top action stays on top and the policy's decision is provably unchanged. The radius exposes a genuine trade-off in σ. More smoothing makes the value function steadier, which helps, but it also compresses the margin between the top two actions, which hurts, so the best amount of noise is a balance rather than a maximum.

zh.caption: 图 1 全部 9 种方法在 Freeway（上）与 Pong（下）上、每一步的动作认证半径 r 随时间的变化；每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL（品红）是最可证明鲁棒的方法；在 Pong 上则是 SA-MDP (CVX)（紫色）领先。阴影为标准差，且很小。

zh.text: 函数平滑：两类标准，三种算法

CROP 的核心引擎是函数平滑（functional smoothing）。在每个状态、针对每个候选动作，方法先用高斯噪声扰动状态，再对训练好的 Q 网络输出在噪声上取平均，得到一个平滑后的值函数。一条关键引理表明，这个平滑值函数是 Lipschitz 连续的，也就是变化不会太快，而且这个常数会随着平滑方差 σ 增大而减小。连续性正是撬动一切的杠杆：既然值函数不会剧烈摆动，小扰动也就无法让所选动作发生翻转。
由这份连续性，论文定义了 2 类认证标准，并把每一类都落成一个具体算法。为了驯服「输出范围未知」这个问题，Q 输出的范围会先在一小部分状态上预估出来，再用集中不等式给平滑值加上界，使得证书在噪声的蒙特卡洛采样下依然可靠。

zh.caption: 表 1 CROP 的三种算法、各自使用的平滑方式，以及它们分别认证的目标。
rows: 单步动作的认证半径 r；扰动在 r 内动作被证明不变
累积奖励的期望界 JE 与 50% 分位界 Jp 两个全局界
累积奖励的绝对下界 J，三者中最紧

zh.text: CROP-LoAct 负责动作层面。对每个状态，它用最优动作与次优动作的平滑值之间的间隔，算出一个认证半径 r：只要扰动小于 r，排在最前的动作就仍然最前，策略的决策便被证明不会改变。这个半径也揭示了 σ 上一个真实的权衡——平滑越多，值函数越稳，这是好事；但它同时压窄了前两个动作之间的间隔，这是坏事。于是最优的噪声量是一个平衡点，而不是越大越好。

zh.title: ICLR 2022 | 强化学习的鲁棒性，不只是测出来，还要证出来
zh.subtitle: CROP：用函数平滑为强化学习策略提供可证明的鲁棒性认证，覆盖动作与累积奖励两个层面

en.caption: Figure 1. Per-state certified action radius r over time for all 9 methods, on Freeway (top) and Pong (bottom); each column is one smoothing variance σ. RadialRL (magenta) is the most certifiably robust method on Freeway, while SA-MDP (CVX) (purple) leads on Pong. Shaded bands are standard deviations and are small.

en.text: Reinforcement learning has quietly moved out of games and simulators and into places where a wrong move is expensive: lane-keeping in self-driving cars, position sizing in automated trading, control loops in robotics. In these settings an agent watches a stream of state observations and picks an action at every step. The uncomfortable part is that those observations can be tampered with. Researchers have shown that an adversary who nudges the input state by an amount too small for a human to notice can reliably flip the agent's decision, and a handful of flipped decisions is all it takes to steer a policy off a cliff.

The usual response has been to make policies empirically tougher through adversarial training, smoothness regularization, or noise injection. Each buys resistance to the attacks it was tested against, and each has, in turn, been broken by a stronger or better-adapted attacker. That cycle exposes the real gap: passing today's attacks tells you almost nothing about tomorrow's. What safety-critical reinforcement learning actually needs is a certificate, a proof that the policy stays reliable against every perturbation within a bounded budget, not merely the specific attacks that someone happened to try.

CROP, presented at ICLR 2022 by researchers from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Washington University in St. Louis, and Carnegie Mellon University, is the first unified framework to provide exactly that for reinforcement learning. It certifies robustness at 2 levels, the stability of the action chosen at each state and a provable lower bound on the cumulative reward collected across an entire trajectory, and uses those tools to benchmark 9 existing robust RL methods across 4 environments on a common, provable footing.
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09292 · Project and leaderboard: https://crop-leaderboard.github.io

zh.title: ICLR 2022 | 强化学习的鲁棒性，不只是测出来，还要证出来
zh.subtitle: CROP：用函数平滑为强化学习策略提供可证明的鲁棒性认证，覆盖动作与累积奖励两个层面

en.text: What the certificates reveal

Running CROP-LoAct across the 9 methods produces a per-state certified radius at every time step, which reads directly as how much perturbation each policy can absorb before its action would flip. The figure below tracks that radius over time on two Atari games, Freeway and Pong, with each column corresponding to a different smoothing level σ.

en.caption: Figure 1. Per-state certified action radius r over time for all 9 methods, on Freeway (top) and Pong (bottom); each column is one smoothing variance σ. RadialRL (magenta) is the most certifiably robust method on Freeway, while SA-MDP (CVX) (purple) leads on Pong. Shaded bands are standard deviations and are small.

en.text: Two clear winners emerge, and they differ by environment. On Freeway, RadialRL holds the highest certified radius across every smoothing level, which fits its design: it explicitly optimizes against worst-case perturbations. On Pong, SA-MDP with the convex relaxation is the most certifiably robust. Reassuringly, these certified rankings line up with what people had already observed empirically. The proof agrees with the practice, and that consistency is what makes a certificate worth trusting.

The per-state view also surfaces structure that a single robustness number would hide. On Pong, every method's certified radius rises and falls in a regular rhythm rather than staying flat, and lining the curve up against the game frames explains why it does so.

en.caption: Figure 7. Two consecutive periods of the certified radius on Pong (top of each panel), aligned with the game frames they correspond to (bottom). Robustness peaks at confident moments, for example when the ball is heading toward the paddle, and dips when the next action matters less. The two periods are nearly identical.

en.text: The reading is intuitive. When the ball is racing toward the paddle the correct action is unambiguous, the margin between the best and second-best action is wide, and the certified radius is large; in the lull between rallies the decision is nearly arbitrary and the radius collapses. This suggests that robustness is not a fixed property of a policy but something that ebbs and flows with how consequential each state is, a hint that future defenses might concentrate their effort on the handful of states that actually matter most.

zh.text: 认证结果告诉了我们什么
把 CROP-LoAct 跑遍 9 种方法，就能得到每一步的认证半径，它可以被直接读作：在动作发生翻转之前，每个策略还能吸收多大的扰动。下图记录了这个半径在两款 Atari 游戏 Freeway 和 Pong 上随时间的变化，每一列对应一个不同的平滑水平 σ。

zh.caption: 图 1 全部 9 种方法在 Freeway（上）与 Pong（下）上、每一步的动作认证半径 r 随时间的变化；每一列对应一个平滑方差 σ。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL（品红）是最可证明鲁棒的方法；在 Pong 上则是 SA-MDP (CVX)（紫色）领先。阴影为标准差，且很小。

zh.text: 两位赢家浮现出来，而且随环境而不同。在 Freeway 上，RadialRL 在每个平滑水平下都保持最高的认证半径，这与它的设计相符：它显式地针对最坏情况扰动做优化。在 Pong 上，采用凸松弛的 SA-MDP (CVX) 最为可证明鲁棒。令人安心的是，这些「可证明」的排名，与人们此前在经验上观察到的结果相互吻合——证明与实践一致，正是这种一致性让一份证书值得信赖。
逐状态的视角还揭示出一个被「单一鲁棒性数字」掩盖的结构。在 Pong 上，每种方法的认证半径并非一条平线，而是有规律地起伏；把这条曲线和游戏画面对齐，原因便一目了然。

zh.caption: 图 7 Pong 上认证半径的两个连续周期（每格上方），与其对应的游戏画面（下方）对齐。鲁棒性在「有把握」的时刻达到峰值——例如球正朝球拍飞来时——而在下一步动作无关紧要时回落。两个周期几乎完全相同。

zh.text: 这个解读很直观：当球正朝球拍飞来，正确的动作毫无悬念，最优与次优动作之间的间隔很宽，认证半径就大；而在两个回合之间的间歇里，选哪个动作都差不多，半径随之塌缩。这表明，鲁棒性并不是策略的一个固定属性，而是随着「每个状态有多关键」而涨落——这也暗示，未来的防御或许可以把力气集中在那些真正要紧的状态上。
到底该平滑多少
既然平滑方差 σ 决定了整份证书，论文就直接研究它，结论是：合适的噪声量取决于环境。在能容忍大扰动的 Freeway 上，强方法的鲁棒性会随 σ 一路上升，直到 1.0。Pong 上则相反：平滑过头会抹平值间隔，对几乎所有方法而言，0.01 到 0.03 之间的中等 σ 最好。并不存在一个通用设置——σ 是一个要按环境去调的旋钮，而 CROP 让这个权衡变得可度量，而不是靠猜。
